description: Agents Kit v2 oturum, mutasyon ve kapanış korumaları.

hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$root/.agents/config.json" ]; then root="$(pwd -P)"; while [ "$root" != / ] && { [ ! -f "$root/AGENTS.md" ] || [ ! -f "$root/.agents/config.json" ]; }; do root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; fi; [ -f "$root/.agents/validators/sh/agent-kit.sh" ] || exit 3; /bin/sh "$root/.agents/validators/sh/agent-kit.sh" session-context --root "$root" --client codex --source hook --format text
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = $null; $git = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($git) { $candidate = (& $git.Source rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null); if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $root = [string]$candidate } }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($root) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root '.agents\config.json') -PathType Leaf)) { $root = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'AGENTS.md') -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root '.agents\config.json') -PathType Leaf)) { break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $root; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parent) -or $parent -eq $root) { throw 'AKE900 project root not found' }; $root = $parent } }; & (Join-Path $root '.agents\validators\ps\agent-kit.ps1') session-context -Root $root -Client codex -Source hook -Format text"
